author_name: วรเศรษฐ์ ศิริอัศวเมธา

text:
I've had my wisdom teeth removed here twice (2 years apart). Two different dentists. The woman who did it 2 years ago had very gentle hands and was very assuring. My recent visit was a different (male) dentist who was more rough (my lips were hurting more from having tools dragged across it than the extraction site itself lol) but in the end, the tooth was extracted safely and my nerves were in tact in the end.

Very clean place. They have a little play area for kids. The admin staffs are very nice and friendly. The pricing is reasonble and they do work with some insurance groups too.

I had my upper left wisdom tooth and lower left wisdom tooth extracted. The dentist was very gentle; it didn't hurt at all. I was home 3 hours later, the anesthetic wore off, and I could eat normally. 🥰😍 The staff at the clinic were all lovely too. …
author_name: นิตยา โชติกูล

text: This is our family's regular clinic; we've been going there for a very long time. They have specialist dentists who can recommend the best treatment for each dental condition. We've been coming here since we were children, and now we even need dentures and dental implants for my mother. Even after moving to Bangkok, we still go back here.
